rules: Use Barlow Condensed (800/900 weight) for hero-level headings, route names, and large metrics. Apply uppercase and tracking-wide.
Use DM Sans for all body text, form labels, and standard UI elements with increased tracking.
Use JetBrains Mono exclusively for the 'Failure Log' to give it a diagnostic, technical terminal feel.
Never use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
No full-screen gradients. Keep backgrounds solid, dark, and tactical.
Use #DFFF00 (Volt Yellow) sparingly as a kinetic trigger for the main running route path, active toggles, and primary CTAs.
Use #00E5FF (Cyan) for water stops and well-lit zone indicators on the map.
Use #FF3B30 (Blaze) for highlighting LLM hallucinations in the Failure Log.
Ensure all neutral grays are tinted slightly blue (cool) to feel technical.

layouts.app_structure: Split-pane SPA layout: 35% Sidebar (Builder/Discovery), 65% Interactive Map view.
layouts.sidebar: Fixed left column, h-screen, scrollable (hide scrollbar). Flat solid surfaces. Dense form layout mimicking an athletic command center.
layouts.map_area: Full height right column, relative positioning. Mapbox Dark v11 base.
layouts.bento_discovery: Use 'High Density Grid' (Mode B) for the Strava-inspired route discovery grid. 1 column on mobile, 2 columns in the sidebar. Tight gap-4, sharp edges.

sidebar_form.style: Tactical Minimalism. No soft shadows. Use 1px solid borders (border-white/10). Form inputs should have flat bg-white/5 backgrounds.
sidebar_form.spacing: Dense hierarchy. space-y-6 between major sections. Use space-y-2 for label-to-input.

failure_log.style: Retro-Futurism 'Terminal' Look. Render inside the sidebar or as a bottom sheet. Deep black background, 1px border-alert, JetBrains Mono font, highlighting how the Map API corrected the LLM's non-closing loops.

narration_panel.style: Crystal Glass variant (Glassmorphism). Floating over the top-right of the map. backdrop-blur-2xl, bg-black/60, 1px inner border-white/20. High-contrast text.

elevation_chart.style: Placed at the bottom of the map area. Solid dark background or heavy glass. Monochromatic chart with #DFFF00 line and gradient fill.

route_card.style: Grid Borders look. Sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-md). Hover: -translate-y-1, hover:bg-white/10, subtle left-border transition.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Mix flat panels (sidebar) with Crystal Glass (map overlays) to create depth. No muddy gray transparency.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px borders everywhere to create a rigid, technical grid feel.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the sidebar background to remove digital flatness.

motion.hover_states: High-contrast color flips (e.g., bg-transparent text-accent -> bg-accent text-black).
motion.transitions: Use transition-colors duration-200 and transition-transform duration-300.
motion.map_animations: Smooth flyTo transitions between Bengaluru and Delhi locations.

bengaluru_morning.description: Bengaluru city skyline at dusk/dawn, use for Bengaluru route discovery cards.

delhi_morning.description: Delhi city skyline, use for Delhi route discovery cards.

running_track.description: Athlete running on track, use for default state or hero banners.

rules: Use specific images for location cards.

accessibility.contrast: All text over map or images must have sufficient text-shadow or a solid scrim.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must use focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#DFFF00].
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels for map controls, sliders, and form toggles.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create a split-pane layout with a Sidebar (left) and Interactive Map (right).
The Sidebar should have two tabs/states: 'Builder' (form) and 'Discover' (Strava-style bento grid).
Do NOT use HTML input type='range' or <select>. Use Shadcn Slider, Select, Checkbox, Tabs.
Implement the 'Failure Log' to demonstrate the LLM vs API routing trade-off. Give it a distinct terminal-like UI using JetBrains Mono.
Implement the 'Narration Panel' as a floating glass card on top of the Mapbox map, narrating the ups and downs of the route.
Implement an Elevation Profile chart using Recharts docked at the bottom of the map.
Ensure the primary map route is drawn using the #DFFF00 (Volt Yellow) color for high visibility.
Add data-testid attributes to all form inputs, tabs, and major panels.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) ONLY for floating panels. Always include a semi-transparent background color (e.g., bg-black/60).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (transition-colors, transition-transform).
Always use modern button styles (sharp corners or max 4px radius) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Do not center align the app container. Maintain left alignment for text readability.
